faqs.question: Is it wrong for a girl to propose first?
faqs.answer: No — it is unusual rather than wrong, and those are different things. A 2022 Socius study found observers rate couples who follow the traditional proposal script as stronger and more likely to last, so the pressure you feel is real, but it is a judgement about the script rather than about your relationship.

faqs.question: Do men actually like being proposed to?
faqs.answer: Nobody has measured it, and a page that tells you otherwise is guessing. The research we could find measures how observers judge a proposal and which women endorse the men-ask script — neither asks men what they want. The only sample that matters is him, and you know it better than any study does.

faqs.question: Can I make a proposal website for my boyfriend without paying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Building a SubhSandesh proposal page costs nothing and takes an afternoon rather than a fortnight. The median gap between a page’s first save and its last edit is 6.3 hours, though that figure is sampled on our “I love you” template (n = 1,136), not on proposals specifically.

faqs.question: Should I buy him a ring if I am proposing?
faqs.answer: Only if you want to. A men’s band in India runs roughly ₹15,000 to ₹1,00,000 and sizing adds about a week, and unlike a woman’s engagement ring it carries no shared script that makes the moment legible. Most couples who do buy one choose it together afterwards.

faqs.question: How do I stop him seeing the proposal page before I am ready?
faqs.answer: Put a password on it and send the password separately, or after he is with you. 40.0% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect a page before sharing (1,809 of 4,524 pages, platform-wide across all page types). It is one extra step and it is the only real control you have over timing.

faqs.question: What should I write on a proposal page for a boyfriend?
faqs.answer: Three specific moments only the two of you remember, then the question. Avoid summarising the relationship — a page rewards detail over ceremony, because he can reread it. Name places, dates and the thing he said that you never forgot.

faqs.question: Is it better to propose to him in person or send a link?
faqs.answer: Send the link when you want privacy, a keepsake, or distance covered; ask in person when he dislikes anything that looks like a gimmick. 48.9% of shared pages are opened on a phone, so a link will reach him wherever he is standing unless you tell him when to open it.

faqs.question: What if he says no, or asks for time?
faqs.answer: A private page handles that far better than a restaurant does, because there is no audience raising the cost of an honest answer. Asking for time is not a no. If you suspect the conversation about marriage has not happened yet, have that conversation before you build anything.

faqs.question: Do I have to tell his parents before I ask him?
faqs.answer: No, and in most Indian families it is better not to. News travels faster than the couple does, and a woman’s proposal gets relitigated by relatives who were not there. Let him have the answer to himself for a day first.

faqs.question: Can I use a proposal website if I am just asking him to be my boyfriend?
faqs.answer: You can, but the marriage-proposal template will read as too heavy. The Invitation template is built for asking someone out — a yes turns into a countdown — and the Court of Love template suits couples where a straight proposal would land badly.

faqs.question: When is Propose Day 2027, and does the leap year matter?
faqs.answer: Propose Day 2027 falls on Monday 8 February 2027. The leap-year custom that supposedly lets women propose on 29 February is Irish folklore called Bachelor’s Day, and the next 29 February is in 2028 — so waiting for it costs you a year for no reason.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Proposal Website for Boyfriend: How to Ask Him Properly

A proposal website for your boyfriend works exactly like any other proposal page — a private link holding your story, your photos and the question, opened on his phone. The awkward part is not the technology.

Search "proposal website for boyfriend" and almost every result is written for a man asking a woman, which tells you what the internet assumes and nothing about your situation. Two numbers from our own database are worth knowing before you build one: 40.0% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect a page before sharing it (1,809 of 4,524 pages), and 48.9% of our 51,164 recorded views happen on a phone. Both figures are platform-wide across all 16 page types, not proposal-specific.

## Is it weird for a woman to propose to her boyfriend?

No. It is unusual, which is a different thing, and the difference is worth holding onto because the two get confused constantly.

The feeling that something is at stake is not imaginary, though. A 2022 study in Socius asked participants to rate hypothetical couples and found that relationships conforming to the traditional engagement proposal script were judged stronger and more likely to last — regardless of the couple's composition. The judgement attaches to the script, not to the relationship.

That is a fact about an audience, not about you. Our opinion, stated plainly: it is a poor reason to wait for someone else to ask a question you already know the answer to.

There is also evidence about who holds these expectations most firmly. A 2023 paper in Sex Roles, across three samples of single women in Australia (N = 112, 157 and 189), found that endorsement of heteronormative dating scripts — men paying, men proposing — was predicted by higher benevolent sexism, higher hostile sexism and lower feminist identity. When someone tells you it is "just tradition", that is the measured company the belief keeps.

## What a proposal website for a boyfriend actually is

It is a single private web page, built from a template, that tells your story in order and ends in a question he answers by tapping. You send it as a link; nothing is installed, and he needs only a browser.

The mechanics are identical whoever is asking. The [SubhSandesh proposal scrapbook template](https://subhsandesh.in/proposal) walks through your story and closes on a YES button that grows every time he dodges it — a joke that works better on a man who will absolutely try to dodge it.

What differs is control. A page can be locked with a password, unlocked in a room you chose, and kept afterwards. A restaurant cannot do any of those three.

People do finish these. 92.9% of pages started on SubhSandesh are published and shared (4,204 of 4,524), which is a platform-wide rate rather than a proposal one, but it suggests the format survives second thoughts better than a speech does.

## Four things that change when you are the one asking

The list below is ordered by how often it actually derails the plan, not by how dramatic it sounds.

### 1. The ring stops being the opening move

A ring is the prop that makes a proposal legible to onlookers, and for a man there is no equivalent object with the same shared meaning. Buying him a ring is fine and increasingly common, but it is a choice rather than a requirement, and it usually lands better chosen together afterwards.

A band is a real expense and getting the size right without tipping him off is its own small project. Skipping it removes both from your timeline, and nothing about the question you are asking depends on it.

### 2. Public or private becomes a real decision

For a man proposing, the public version is the default and the private version is the deviation. For you, neither is the default, which means you have to actually pick.

A crowd raises the cost of a hesitant yes for him — he now has an audience to perform for. With 48.9% of shared pages opened on a phone, a link will likely reach him wherever he is standing, so if you want privacy, say when to open it. Preparing a private ask takes hours, not weeks.

### 3. Who you tell first changes the reception

In most Indian families the news travels faster than the couple does, and a woman's proposal gets relitigated by relatives who were not there. The practical move is to let him have the answer to himself for a day before anyone else hears.

This is precisely what the password field is for: 40.0% of our creators use one before sharing, a platform-wide figure across 4,524 pages and not a proposal-specific rate. It costs one extra step and buys you the whole first day.

### 4. There is no script, so you write one

A man proposing can borrow a complete sequence — dinner, walk, knee, box. You have no inherited sequence, which is genuinely harder for an evening and genuinely better for a page, because a page rewards specific content over ceremony.

Write the three moments only the two of you remember. The median SubhSandesh page sits 6.3 hours between first save and last edit — a figure sampled on our "I love you" template (n = 1,136), not on proposals — so plan for an afternoon of revising, not ten minutes.

## How the ways of asking him compare

The comparison below is about control and preparation time, which are the two variables that actually differ.

| Way of asking | Cost | Prep time before you ask | Control over who sees it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Private proposal page link | Free to build | Median 6.3 hours between first save and last edit (sampled on /love-gf, n = 1,136) | Full — 40.0% of creators add a password (1,809 of 4,524, platform-wide) |
| Ring first, then ask | ₹15,000–₹1,00,000+ | 1–3 weeks including sizing | Full, if you ask privately |
| Restaurant or public setup | ₹3,000–₹25,000 | 3–10 days, booking-dependent | None — staff and strangers are the audience |
| Video call, long distance | Free | Minutes | Full, but nothing survives the call |

The takeaway: the page and the video call both protect him from an audience, and only the page leaves something he can reopen later.

## The leap-year story, and why it is context rather than advice

Someone will tell you women are "allowed" to propose on 29 February. That custom is Bachelor's Day, also called Ladies' Privilege — an Irish tradition traced to a legend in which Saint Bridget asked Saint Patrick in the 5th century for a day when women could propose, and negotiated him from one day in seven years to one in four.

The version people quote as law is worse than folklore. A Scottish statute of 1288 supposedly fined any man who refused, decreed by Queen Margaret — who was five years old at the time, and the fine has no basis in historical fact.

Two practical notes. The next 29 February falls in 2028, not 2027, and Propose Day 2027 is Monday 8 February 2027. Waiting for a date that grants you permission is a way of accepting that permission was required.

## What this research does not say about India

Honestly: none of the proposal-script studies we could find are Indian. The Socius work sampled college students at a midwestern American university, and the Sex Roles samples were Australian. We fetched the abstracts of both and are citing only what the abstracts state.

The closest Indian evidence is adjacent rather than direct. A 2014 comparative study in Frontiers in Psychology found Indians scored higher than Americans on collectivism and gender-role traditionalism, and that this predicted stronger romantic beliefs and more traditional mate preferences. A 2025 Journal of Family Issues study, from 40 interviews with middle-class young Indians, found self-choice marriage described as carrying real stigma, with arranged marriage treated as the "safest" option because parental backing insures the couple against later trouble.

Neither measures who proposes. So the honest position is that the direction of the Western findings is plausible here and the Indian number does not exist. We would rather say that than quietly present an American sample as though it described Delhi.

## When a proposal page is the wrong choice

If he is the kind of person who would rather be asked in a room containing two people and no screens, send nothing. A link opens wherever he happens to be, and a proposal read in an office corridor is a worse memory than a bad dinner.

If marriage has not been discussed at all, a proposal is the wrong instrument. So is a page dressed up as one.

The [Court of Love template](https://subhsandesh.in/court-of-love) puts him on trial with ten funny questions and a penguin judge, which is the right weight for a couple where a straight proposal would land badly. If you are asking him out rather than asking him to marry you, [the Invitation template](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) turns a yes into a countdown instead.

And if his phone is old, his data is patchy, or he genuinely dislikes anything that looks like a gimmick, ask him in person. We would rather lose the page than the yes. You can [browse every SubhSandesh template](https://subhsandesh.in/templates) if none of the three above fits, but the honest answer for some couples is a conversation, not a link.

## Sources

Five sources carry this page: two peer-reviewed open-access studies of proposal scripts, one India-inclusive comparison, one paywalled Indian interview study read at abstract only, and one encyclopaedia entry for the leap-year custom. Three of the five publisher pages — both SAGE articles and the Springer one — refused our automated requests, so those findings were checked against the DOAJ and OpenAlex records for the same DOIs rather than by loading the articles in full.

- [Conformity to Heterosexual Engagement Proposal Scripts: Do Same-Sex Couples Benefit?](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/23780231221139119) — Socius, December 2022. Open access; abstract read.
- [Women's Endorsement of Heteronormative Dating Scripts is Predicted by Sexism, Feminist Identity, A Preference for Dominant Men, and A Preference Against Short-Term Relationships](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11199-023-01405-6) — Sex Roles, 24 July 2023, CC BY.
- [Romantic ideals, mate preferences, and anticipation of future difficulties in marital life: a comparative study of young adults in India and America](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2014.01355/full) — Frontiers in Psychology, 2 December 2014, CC BY.
- ["Marriage is a Complete Gamble": Marriage Attitudes of the Indian Middle Class](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/0192513X251356261) — Journal of Family Issues, 4 July 2025. Paywalled; abstract only.
- [Bachelor's Day (tradition)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor%27s_Day_(tradition)) — Wikipedia, for the leap-year custom and the 1288 story.

auditReport.honestAssessment: REWRITTEN AFTER THE FIX PASS. An answer engine asked "can a woman propose to her boyfriend with a website" has, today, only pages written for the opposite case: 9 of 9 organic results are for a man asking a woman, and subhsandesh.in itself has 29 live articles with "propos" in the slug, none boyfriend-facing. That is the whole case for citation — the page answers the gender-flipped question directly, names four concrete differences (ring, public-or-private, who hears first, no inherited script), cites the proposal-script literature by name against a SERP that cites nothing, and states outright that no Indian study of who proposes exists. Nothing in the fix pass changed that calculus in either direction. WHAT THE FIX PASS CLOSED: the Sources section now opens with a standalone answer and discloses in body prose that three of the five publisher pages refused automated requests, which was previously admitted only in the audit; six over-long paragraphs were split; a duplicate FAQ that restated the "is it weird" H2 almost verbatim was replaced. WHAT IT COULD NOT CLOSE, and these are real: (1) no proposal-specific first-party figures were obtainable for this batch — the proposalpages probe was blocked by production-read policy — so every SubhSandesh number here (40.0% password rate, 48.9% phone views, 92.9% publish rate, 6.3-hour edit gap) is platform-wide or /love-gf-sampled and is labelled as such in the body; a proposal-template password rate would have been materially stronger and does not exist yet. (2) Three of five citations were verified through DOAJ and OpenAlex records rather than by loading the publisher pages, and this pass had no web-fetch tool with which to re-attempt them or substitute a fetchable source. (3) The Frontiers 2014 India/America comparison fails the swap test and was kept because the alternative is an India section with no evidence at all. (4) The girlfriend-facing template counts (/love-gf, /bouquet-gf, /birthday-gf) are deliberately unused — they are evidence about girlfriend pages and would misrepresent a post about proposing to a man. PROSPECTS, stated plainly: domain authority on this query is zero, none of the site's proposal pages ranked in any of the 11 SERPs measured, and the incumbents are product pages with signup intent and inbound product links. On classic ranking this post should not be expected to beat the top five within this batch's horizon; its realistic route is answer-engine citation for the boyfriend-facing sub-question, where being the only page that addresses it counts for more than authority does. What would change the classic-ranking picture is internal links from the site's existing 29 proposal articles and a proposal-specific first-party number, neither of which this pass could create. A ring price range (₹15,000–₹1,00,000) and a sizing lead time were removed after batch verification: neither was supported by any of this post's sources, and no citable figure for Indian men's bands was available to replace them.
